fact: The Government of Cabo Verde states that electronic public procurement has existed since 2020, with Central State Administration procedures progressively carried out through the official public purchasing portal.
system: official public procurement portal (portal oficial de compras públicas)

fact: The Government of Cabo Verde states that a new e-procurement platform was awarded to ACIN-iCloud Solutions for CVE 70,000,000 over four years, to extend the platform to local administration and autonomous services and funds.
Minister Edna Oliveira cited Cabo Verde's electronic public procurement platform as a transparency measure showing criteria and processes for awarding public contracts.
